name: Research Agent
description: Conducts web research and produces structured reports with citations on any business topic.

specJson.goal: Research project management productivity tools on the internet and bring back a top 10 list ranked by GitHub stars and GitHub/Reddit comments
steps: Search for open source project management tools using web search
Filter results to include only open source tools
Gather GitHub repository data including star counts for each tool
Collect Reddit comments and engagement metrics for each tool
Rank the tools based on combined GitHub stars and Reddit comment scores
Select top 10 ranked tools from the research findings
